# KD SONDAJ — Heavy Drilling Rigs & Borehole Equipment Manufacturer

> KD SONDAJ is an Ankara, Turkey-based heavy rotary drilling machinery manufacturer with 45 years of continuous engineering heritage, certified under CE and ISO 9001:2015. The company specializes in manufacturing truck-mounted and trailer-mounted rotary drilling rigs with capacities ranging from 250 to 3,000 meters (820 to 9,840 ft) for deep water wells, high-enthalpy geothermal reservoirs, mining exploration, and oilfield services.

## Verified Factory Specifications
- **Headquarters & Manufacturing Plant:** Mustafa Kemal Mh. 2125 Sk. No: 9/10, Çankaya, Ankara, Turkey
- **Direct Engineering & Export RFQ Hotline:** +90 541 191 63 01 (WhatsApp / Phone)
- **Official Email:** info@kdsondaj.com
- **Official Domain:** https://kdsondaj.com.tr
- **Quality Certifications:** CE Conformity Declaration, ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management
- **Key Target Export Markets:** GCC (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Iraq), Africa (Egypt, Algeria, Libya, Kenya, Nigeria), Central Asia, and Europe

## Rotary Drilling Rig Catalog (250 – 3,000 m)
- [KD-3000 Heavy Trailer Rig (1500–3000m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/1500-3000m-trailer-drilling-rig/): 110-ton mast hook-load, 90-ton drawworks, 525 HP diesel engine, deep geothermal and deep aquifer development.
- [KD-2500 Special Rig (2500m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/2500m-special-deep-drilling-rig/): Dual MAN 422 diesel engines, 14.50m mast, integrated 7.5x10 duplex mud pump, heavy exploration.
- [KD-1200 Truck-Mounted Rig (1000–1200m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/1000-1200m-truck-mounted-drilling-rig/): 90-ton mast, 70-ton drawworks, 422 HP engine, rapid highway mobilization for regional water wells.
- [KD-1200-T Trailer Rig (1000–1200m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/1000-1200m-trailer-drilling-rig/): 110-ton mast, 525 HP diesel engine, heavy casing program support.
- [KD-800 Truck-Mounted Rig (800m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/800m-truck-mounted-drilling-rig/): 361 HP diesel engine, 70-ton mast, 50-ton drawworks, dual mud circulation for agricultural irrigation.
- [KD-800-T Trailer Rig (800m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/800m-trailer-drilling-rig/): 70-ton mast, 361 HP engine, stable semi-trailer platform.
- [KD-500 Truck-Mounted Rig (300–500m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/300-500m-truck-mounted-drilling-rig/): 321 HP engine, 60-ton mast, fast-moving agile rig for shallow to mid-depth wells.
- [KD-600-T Trailer Rig (400–600m)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/400-600m-trailer-drilling-rig/): 60-ton mast, 321 HP diesel engine.

## Drilling Consumables & Ancillary Equipment
- [API Spec 5D Drill Pipes (2 3/8" to 5 1/2")](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/api-spec-5d-drill-pipes/): High-tensile alloy steel in grades E-75, X-95, G-105, and S-135 with friction-welded tool joints.
- [IADC Tricone Rock Drill Bits (111 to 637)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/iadc-tricone-drill-bits/): Tungsten Carbide Insert (TCI) and milled steel tooth roller cone bits for soft clays to hard granites.
- [KD 6" Duplex Mud Pump (21–62 Bar)](https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/duplex-6-inch-mud-pump/): Double-acting reciprocating mud pump delivering up to 62 bar (895 psi) and 12.5 L/stroke.

# DETAILED TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX

### Model: KD-3000 Heavy Trailer-Mounted Rotary Drilling Rig (1500–3000 m)
- URL: https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/1500-3000m-trailer-drilling-rig/
- Depth Capacity: 1500–3000 m
- Engine Power: 525 HP
- Mast Hook-Load: 110 t
- Drawworks Rating: 90 t
- Mud Pump: Integrated Duplex / Triplex High Pressure
- Recommended Formations: Dense basalt, granite, quartzite, hard limestone, and high-temperature geothermal volcanic rock formations.
#### Specifications Table:
  - Drilling Depth Capacity: 1500 – 3000 m (4,920 – 9,840 ft)
  - Gross Mast Hook-Load: 110 Metric Tons (242,500 lbs)
  - Main Drawworks Rating: 90 Metric Tons
  - Deck Power Unit: 525 HP Heavy Industrial Diesel Engine
  - Rotary Table Drive: High Torque Mechanical / Hydraulic Slide (ID 240mm / OD 700mm)
  - Drilling Mud Circulation: Double Circulation High-Pressure Mud Line
  - Carrier Configuration: Heavy Duty Multi-Axle Lowbed Semi-Trailer
  - Hydraulic Leveling: 4 Double-Cylinder Heavy Jack Legs
  - Drill Pipe Compatibility: 3 1/2" to 5 1/2" API Spec 5D Drill Pipe
  - International Standard: CE Certified & ISO 9001:2015 Manufacturing

### Model: KD-2500 Special Deep Rotary Drilling Rig (2500 m)
- URL: https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/2500m-special-deep-drilling-rig/

- Mast Hook-Load: 14.50 m / 8 mm

- Mud Pump: 7.5" × 10" Duplex
- Recommended Formations: Abrasive quartzite, andesite, basalt, massive limestone, and complex tectonic strata.

  - Mast Specifications: 14.50 m Height, 8 mm Heavy Pipe, 4" Main Legs

  - Integrated Mud Pump: 7.5" × 10" Heavy Duplex Mud Pump

- Drawworks Rating: Journal & Roller
- Mud Pump: Air / Mud Jet
- Recommended Formations: From soft clays and gravels to medium abrasive sandstones and hard granites.

  - Cutting Structure: Tungsten Carbide Inserts (TCI) & Steel Milled Tooth
  - Diameter Range: 3 7/8" to 26" (98 mm to 660 mm)
  - Bearing Types: Sealed Journal Bearings, Roller Bearings, Air Bearings
  - Gauge Protection: Full Tungsten Carbide Insert Hardfacing on Gauge

### Model: KD 6" Duplex Drilling Mud Pump (21–62 Bar)
- URL: https://kdsondaj.com.tr/en/equipment/drilling-rigs/duplex-6-inch-mud-pump/
- Depth Capacity: 6" Stroke / 62 Bar
- Engine Power: V-Gear Piston
- Mast Hook-Load: 2 Piston / Double Acting
- Drawworks Rating: 70 rpm — 4.5 to 12.5 lt
- Mud Pump: 21 – 62 bar (310 – 895 psi)
- Recommended Formations: Universal for all geological formations requiring positive displacement mud hydraulics.
#### Specifications Table:
  - Pump Type: Duplex Double-Acting Reciprocating Piston Pump
  - Stroke Length: 6" (152.4 mm)
  - Piston Count: 2 Double-Acting Pistons
  - Operating Speed: 70 RPM Recommended Operational Cadence
  - Working Pressure: Up to 62 bar / 895 psi (with 3" Liner)
  - Discharge Flow Rate: 4.5 to 12.5 Liters per stroke depending on liner
  - Suction / Discharge: 4" Suction / 2" Discharge Port
  - Overall Weight: 2,100 kg (Heavy Cast Industrial Housing)


# TECHNICAL PROCUREMENT RFQ CHECKLIST
When requesting a quotation for KD Sondaj equipment, international buyers should specify:
1. Final completed borehole depth (m or ft)
2. Surface and production casing programs (outer diameter and weight per foot)
3. Rotary table torque vs. top-drive hydraulic requirement
4. Air compressor CFM/PSI needs if DTH air percussion drilling is required
5. Discharge port and customs delivery terms (FOB Mersin/Izmir, CIF, or DDP)
